summary: Verified the ticket preview navigation bug fix on /staff. Mobile (390x844) and tablet (1200x800) flows both pass: staff-ticket-preview button now correctly navigates to /staff/ticket/{id}. On phone width the detail modal closes first (setTimeout 350ms) then navigates; on tablet two-column layout it navigates directly. Ticket screen renders paper with 'HALLO MAGIC PIZZA' and 'COMMANDE #<n>'. Reprint button increments ticket-print-status counter (Imprime 2x -> 3x). Direct URL /staff/ticket/{id} loads correctly when unlocked. Header back button returns to dashboard.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' emitted on staff/ticket screens. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/staff/ticket/[id].tsx:51 (paper style uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' triggered during reprint action (likely from a Button loading state). Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional cleanup (not blocking): migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in the ticket paper style (/app/frontend/app/staff/ticket/[id].tsx paper style) and any pointerEvents usage to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: openTicket() in /app/frontend/src/components/staff-order.tsx (lines 74-81) correctly branches on presence of onClose (Modal on phone vs. two-column on tablet) and uses a 350ms delay before router.push - matches the bug fix and works as expected in tests.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Ticket preview navigation from /staff to /staff/ticket/{id} verified on 390x844 and 1200x800. testIDs used: staff-pin-input, staff-pin-submit, staff-dashboard-title, staff-filter-progress, staff-order-card-{id}, staff-order-detail, staff-ticket-preview, ticket-paper, ticket-text, ticket-print-status, ticket-print-button, ticket-reprint-button, header-back-button. On phones the button lives at the bottom of a RN ScrollView inside a Modal - use el.scrollIntoView or scroll the ancestor ScrollView container (Playwright's built-in scroll_into_view_if_needed may report 'outside of viewport' because RN Web uses translate transforms).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: on phone (<900px), OrderDetail is rendered inside a React Native <Modal>. Previously the ticket-preview button called router.push while the modal was still visible, so the ticket screen mounted behind the modal and appeared as a no-op. Fix in /app/frontend/src/components/staff-order.tsx openTicket(): when onClose (i.e. rendered in the phone modal) is provided, it first calls onClose() and defers router.push by 350ms so the modal fully dismisses before navigation; otherwise it navigates directly. Confirmed working in both viewports.
